top_signals.title: An ETF That Tracks Employees' 'HAPI'-Ness
top_signals.summary: David van Adelsberg, founding partner & CEO at Irrational Capital, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the Harbor Human Capital Factor US Large Cap ETF (ticker: HAPI), which tracks companies based on the happiness of their employees.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: UK regulators to develop tokenization roadmap after industry feedback
top_signals.summary: The FCA received 123 responses to its wholesale tokenization consultation, with most respondents identifying post-trade processes as the main opportunity for adoption.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
